data.exact_reserve_text: The net favourable development on prior accident year losses of GBP 25.7m (2016 GBP 22.3m favourable development).
data.standardized_narrative: The report records a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 25.7m for 2017 (a release). The figure quoted in the Managing Agent's report is a net (after reinsurance) amount; a gross prior-year movement could not be located with confidence in the published notes available in the images. The release is described as driven by favourable prior accident year claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: net favourable development on prior accident year losses of GBP 25.7m (2016 GBP 22.3m favourable development)
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction limited by image quality and rotated pages. The only explicit prior-year movement found in the visible Managing Agent's Report is a net (after reinsurance) release of GBP 25.7m (quoted on page 1). No unambiguous GROSS prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities column) was located in the movement/reconciliation notes or a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table in the provided images. The closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2016 (opening reserves for 2017) was not reliably identified in the balance sheet images available. The segmental gross premium breakdown (regulatory classes) and a parsed gross claims development triangle exist in the document but could not be confidently extracted from the provided images; therefore those fields are left blank. The prior-year development figure used is NET of reinsurance and is flagged accordingly.
